files.description:
The glob(s) of path(s) to modules containing your event declarations.

If this property is not specified, then the paths given in the
`include` property of your package's `tsconfig.json` will be used.

main.description: The `name` of the interface that holds your `main` event declarations.

name.description: The name of the interface type.

path.description: The path of the module that contains the interface type.

outPath.description: Where the module containing the `declare module` blocks will be written.

renderer.description: The `name` of the interface that holds your `renderer` event declarations.

name.description: The name of the interface type.

path.description: The path of the module that contains the interface type.
